full_judgment: 4. The defendant Nos.1-3, 6, 11, 16, 20 and 24 entered appearance in the suit by filing joint written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint contending inter alia that the suit property under CS Khatian No.11 was auction sold and Abdul Hakim Majumder auction purchased the Jote under CS Khatian No.11 and got possession of the same excepting 7 decimals of land under plot No.360 and 13 decimals of land under Plot No. 361 and 4 decimals of land under Plot No. 365 total 24 decimals of land and for possession of which Abdul Hakim Majumder filed Civil Suit No. 19 of 1939 in the Court of 3rd Munsif, Comilla against the predecessor of the plaintiffs Dula Mia and Sekandar Ali and others. The suit was disposed of in terms of Solenama with the defendant Nos.1-3, 15-18 of that suit. According to the terms of Solenama 45 decimals of land including 24 decimals of land was given settlement in favour of Sekandar Ali and Dula Mia for 5 years and after expiry of the said period since Dula Mia and his brother Sekandar Ali did not execute any Kabuliyat in favour of Abdul Hakim Majumder he filed Other Suit No. 92 of 1942 against them for recovery of possession of that land. In execution of that suit he got possession over the same on 7-2-1943.
